title: TWiT+ Club Shows: Photo Time With Chris Marquardt #21: Rugged | TWiT.TV
text:
Aug 21st 2026

Smart Telescopes, GoPro’s Struggles, and New Battery Tech

It’s Photo Time with Chris Marquardt and Anthony Nielsen! This month’s assignment theme was “Rugged”—from tenacious weeds conquering concrete to weathered classic cars and textured reptilian skin.

⭐️ Highlights:- Assignment Critique: Chris Marquardt and Anthony Nielsen review club members’ creative shots tackling “rugged,” discuss the storytelling behind each image, and introduce the next assignment: “Smooth.”- Photo News: Smart telescopes making astrophotography accessible (and why you may not need to drive out to dark-sky parks), GoPro’s business struggles, and gimbal cameras come to the smartphone.- Gadgets & Trends: Batteries with built-in AirTag tracking, customizable 3D-printed lens “armor,” and the curious revival of 110 film in brand-new 3D-printed cartridges.- Q&A: Titling your photos - why it matters, how to keep it simple, and app picks for authentic film emulation on your smartphone.

📷 Next Assignment: Smooth- Submit to the Tech Guy Flickr group: https://www.flickr.com/groups/techguy- Tag your photo: TGsmooth
